title: The picked sound opens on the channel strip the audio mock draws
goal: When a piece of sound is picked, the panel shows a Channel section like the audio mock: the file name beside the header, Mute and Solo buttons, and a Volume slider in decibels. Today the section is called Sound, has a Level slider, and has no Mute or Solo.
notes: Found while building the Fades section (a-sound-shows-its-fade-in-and-fade-out-as-the-mo, 2026-09-25). Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-audio.html lines ~214-221 (.section Channel: .btnrow chMute/chSolo, .slrow chVol -24..+6 dB). App: Sources/Photonz/SoundInspector.swift (SoundInspector: Level slider + Points/Flatten), section title in InspectorSections.swift (.sound "Sound"). Track mute/solo already exist on track headers (DocumentTracks.swift, layersSilencedByTrack); the panel buttons should drive those, not a second mute. Keep the Points/Flatten row or fold it in; decide against the mock.
acceptance: With a sound picked, the panel has a section headed Channel with the file name beside it, as pages/video-audio.html draws #propBody
Mute and Solo buttons sit under the header and do the same thing as the mute and solo on that sound track, as one undo step each
The level row reads Volume with its decibels at the end, as the mock draws it
A walk with no flags picks the sample music, mutes it, solos it and reads each back
